data.summary: NetzMuster GmbH sent a second reminder for the unpaid February 2026 invoice. The total due is €49.99 (€44.99 plus a €5.00 reminder fee), to be received by 7 April 2026.
data.explanation: Your internet provider says the February 2026 invoice is still unpaid despite an earlier payment reminder. A €5.00 reminder fee has been added. Please pay €49.99 so it arrives by 7 April 2026, or the provider may block your connection. If you already paid, the letter says to treat it as settled, but check your bank statement. If you think the claim is wrong, contact the provider.
